verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶֽל־ הַנְּחִיל֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ אֲמָרַ֖י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה׀ יְהוָ֗ה בִּ֣ינָה הֲגִֽיגִי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ’el- han·nə·ḥî·lō·wṯ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ă·mā·ray ha·’ă·zî·nāh Yah·weh bî·nāh hă·ḡî·ḡî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster to be accompanied by flutes A Psalm of David Give ear to my words O LORD consider my groaning
verses.literalPt: DÁ ouvidos às minhas palavras, ó SENHOR, atende à minha meditação.

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה׀ לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי־ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: haq·šî·ḇāh lə·qō·wl šaw·‘î mal·kî wê·lō·hāy kî- ’ê·le·ḵā ’eṯ·pal·lāl
verses.literal: Attend to the sound of my cry my King and my God for to You I pray
verses.literalPt: Atende à voz do meu clamor, Rei meu e Deus meu, pois a ti orarei.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶר תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ־ לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bō·qer tiš·ma‘ qō·w·lî bō·qer ’e·‘ĕ·rāḵ- lə·ḵā wa·’ă·ṣap·peh
verses.literal: In the morning O LORD You hear my voice at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation
verses.literalPt: Pela manhã ouvirás a minha voz, ó SENHOR; pela manhã apresentarei a ti a minha oração, e vigiarei.

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ לֹ֤א אֵֽל־ חָפֵ֘ץ רֶ֥שַׁע׀ אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְךָ֣ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ’êl- ḥā·p̄êṣ re·ša‘ ’āt·tāh lō yə·ḡur·ḵā rā‘
verses.literal: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness no evil can dwell with You
verses.literalPt: Porque tu não és um Deus que tenha prazer na iniqüidade, nem contigo habitará o mal.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ הֽ֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כָּל־ פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū hō·wl·lîm lə·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·ne·ḵā śā·nēʾ·t̲ā kāl- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: The boastful . . . cannot stand in Your presence You hate all workers of iniquity
verses.literalPt: Os loucos não pararão à tua vista; odeias a todos os que praticam a maldade.

verses.original: תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֪י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ־ דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב׀ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tə·’ab·bêḏ dō·ḇə·rê ḵā·zāḇ ’îš- dā·mîm ū·mir·māh yə·ṯā·‘êḇ Yah·weh
verses.literal: You destroy those who tell lies the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit
verses.literalPt: Destruirás aqueles que falam a mentira; o SENHOR aborrecerá o homem sanguinário e fraudulento.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל־ הֵֽיכַל־ קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî bə·rōḇ ḥas·də·ḵā ’ā·ḇō·w ḇê·ṯe·ḵā ’eš·ta·ḥă·weh ’el- hê·ḵal- qāḏ·šə·ḵā bə·yir·’ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple
verses.literalPt: Porém eu entrarei em tua casa pela grandeza da tua benignidade; e em teu temor me inclinarei para o teu santo templo.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ נְחֵ֬נִי בְצִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑י הוֹשַׁר לְפָנַ֣י דַּרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh nə·ḥê·nî ḇə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯe·ḵā lə·ma·‘an šō·wr·rāy hō·šar lə·p̄ā·nay dar·ke·ḵā
verses.literal: Lead me O LORD in Your righteousness because of my enemies make straight Your way before me
verses.literalPt: SENHOR, guia-me na tua justiça, por causa dos meus inimigos; endireita diante de mim o teu caminho.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּפִ֡יהוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ קִרְבָּ֪ם הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קֶֽבֶר־ פָּת֥וּחַ גְּרוֹנָ֑ם לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗ם יַחֲלִֽיקוּן׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ên bə·p̄î·hū nə·ḵō·w·nāh qir·bām haw·wō·wṯ qe·ḇer- pā·ṯū·aḥ gə·rō·w·nām lə·šō·w·nām ya·ḥă·lî·qūn
verses.literal: For not a word they speak can be trusted destruction lies within them Their throats are open graves their tongues practice deceit
verses.literalPt: Porque não há retidão na boca deles; as suas entranhas são verdadeiras maldades, a sua garganta é um sepulcro aberto; lisonjeiam com a sua língua.

verses.original: הַֽאֲשִׁימֵ֨ם׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽמֹּעֲצ֪וֹתֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּרֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑מוֹ כִּי־ מָ֥רוּ בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·šî·mêm ’ĕlō·hîm yip·pə·lū mim·mō·‘ă·ṣō·w·ṯê·hem bə·rōḇ piš·‘ê·hem had·dî·ḥê·mōw kî- mā·rū ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Declare them guilty O God let them fall by their own devices Drive them out for their many transgressions for they have rebelled against You
verses.literalPt: Declara-os culpados, ó Deus; caiam por seus próprios conselhos; lança-os fora por causa da multidão de suas transgressões, pois se rebelaram contra ti.

verses.original: וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל־ ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡ךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ימוֹ וְֽיַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝ךָ֗ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiś·mə·ḥū ḵāl ḥō·w·sê ḇāḵ lə·‘ō·w·lām yə·ran·nê·nū wə·ṯā·sêḵ ‘ā·lê·mōw wə·ya‘·lə·ṣū ḇə·ḵā ’ō·hă·ḇê šə·me·ḵā
verses.literal: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice let them ever shout for joy . . . May You shelter them that those who love Your name may rejoice in You
verses.literalPt: Porém alegrem-se todos os que confiam em ti; exultem eternamente, porquanto tu os defendes; e em ti se gloriem os que amam o teu nome.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּה֮ תְּבָרֵ֪ךְ צַ֫דִּ֥יק יְהוָ֑ה כַּ֝צִּנָּ֗ה רָצ֥וֹן תַּעְטְרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh tə·ḇā·rêḵ ṣad·dîq Yah·weh kaṣ·ṣin·nāh rā·ṣō·wn ta‘·ṭə·ren·nū
verses.literal: For surely You O LORD bless the righteous You surround them with the shield of Your favor
verses.literalPt: Pois tu, SENHOR, abençoarás ao justo; circundá-lo-ás da tua benevolência como de um escudo.
